title: Road safety and road traffic accidents
competency: Explain basic road safety rules and the socio-economic effects of road accidents.

keywords.def: Methods and measures used to prevent road users from being killed or injured.
When a moving vehicle crashes with another vehicle or object.
Signs that give information, instructions or warnings to road users.

en.text: Road safety means methods and measures to stop road users being killed or injured. Road users are pedestrians, cyclists, motorists and passengers. Pedestrians should use sidewalks and cross carefully. Drivers must never drink and drive, never break a red signal, and keep to speed limits.

screens.title: Crossing the road
screens.ask: Hiwot wants to cross a busy road in Addis Ababa. What is the safest thing to do?
opts: Use the zebra crossing and wait for a gap
screens.after: Use a crossing and wait for a safe gap in the traffic. Never jump over railings.

ideas.name: Road traffic accidents and their effects

en.text: A road traffic accident happens when a moving vehicle crashes with another vehicle or object. Accidents cause loss of life, injuries, disability, dependency, poverty and destroyed property. They cost treatment, lost work time and skilled workers. Pedestrians, cyclists and motorcyclists are the most vulnerable.

screens.title: Who is most at risk?
screens.ask: Who are involved in more than half of all road deaths and injuries?
screens.after: Vulnerable road users: pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists and their passengers.

screens.title: Road traffic accidents and their effects
paras: A road traffic accident occurs when a moving vehicle crashes with another vehicle or object.
Accidents cause loss of lives, more dependency, destroyed property, more poverty, injuries and permanent disability.
They cause economic losses: cost of treatment, lost productivity, lost working time for victims and relatives, and loss of skilled labour.
More than half of road deaths and injuries involve pedestrians, cyclists and motorcyclists.

opts: Loss of working time for victims and relatives
screens.ans: Loss of working time for victims and relatives
screens.why: Lost working time is an economic loss.
screens.clue: Which one costs work and money?

screens.text: A minibus driver who supports five family members is disabled in a crash. Which effects follow? Choose the best answer.
opts: Disability, more dependency and more poverty for the family
screens.ans: Disability, more dependency and more poverty for the family
screens.why: The driver cannot work, so the family loses income and depends on others. This is disability, dependency and poverty.
screens.clue: Think about who depends on his income.
